subject.title: Flaky tests on Windows/WSL: timeouts and ENOENT in pi-tools workspace-paths & safe-bins

question: Should https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90273 stop claiming to close this pi-tools issue before the issue is closed as resolved?
rationale: The original failure mechanisms appear absent on current main, but the only open closing PR modifies an adjacent test suite and GitHub would otherwise conflate two distinct test problems.

options.title: Correct link, then close
options.body: Remove the closing reference from the fs-safe PR, run the focused pi-tools tests on Windows or WSL, and close this issue if they remain green.

options.title: Intentionally broaden ownership
options.body: Keep the closing relationship only if maintainers explicitly decide the fs-safe PR should own this separate pi-tools report and expand its scope and proof accordingly.

recommendation.title: Correct link, then close
recommendation.body: Remove the closing reference from the fs-safe PR, run the focused pi-tools tests on Windows or WSL, and close this issue if they remain green.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest recent history on the affected tests and already defined the narrow resolution boundary in the issue discussion.
